title: arenaria hispanica
intro: Arenaria hispanica, commonly known as Spanish sandwort, is a plant species in the carnation family (Caryophyllaceae). It is used in traditional medicine due to its various health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Arenaria hispanica include antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. The plant's bioactive constituents contribute to its potential therapeutic applications in treating various conditions, such as gastrointestinal disorders and skin issues.
